business: Eternal operates a technology-enabled multi-segment platform in India providing food delivery, quick commerce (e-grocery), going-out experiences (dining, movies, events), and B2B restaurant supplies. Revenue from marketplace commissions, platform fees, and direct inventory-based sales.

segments.name: Quick Commerce
segments.comment: Largest segment, 626% growth YoY; shifted to inventory model for pricing control

segments.name: Food Delivery
segments.comment: Core business, 26% growth; driven by order volumes and revenue per order

segments.name: B2B Supplies
segments.comment: Declined 13%; core restaurant supplies growing despite non-restaurant business scale-down

segments.name: Going-out
segments.comment: 32% growth; first full year post-entertainment ticketing acquisition

revenue_mix: Predominantly India-based, concentrated in top-tier urban metros. Quick commerce revenue now includes full monetary value of goods sold (not just commissions) following inventory model transition.
strategy: Shift from rapid expansion to disciplined cost efficiency and profitability focus
Inventory-owned quick commerce model for margin and pricing control
EV-based logistics transition to mitigate fuel costs and macro headwinds
Scale user retention through affordability features and consumer-centric offerings
Establish exclusive partnerships for premium event inventory access
outlook: Management prioritizes sustained efficiency, operational discipline, and differentiated consumer offerings to maintain ecosystem leadership. Focus on long-term value creation and regulatory compliance amid intensifying competition.
capex_plans: Strategic EV-based logistics transition mentioned for Zomato and Blinkit; specific capital expenditure amounts not disclosed in provided sections.
risks: Intensifying competition from capital-fueled quick commerce rivals with aggressive pricing tactics
Evolving regulatory framework including new Labor Codes and stringent platform governance requirements
Labor volatility and gig worker strikes threatening last-mile fulfillment continuity and order volumes
Macro-economic fluctuations and geopolitical volatility compressing consumer spending and logistics margins
flags: CEO transition: Deepinder Goyal resigned Feb 1, 2026; Albinder Dhindsa appointed. Multiple subsidiary dissolutions in FY26. Clean unmodified audit opinions. No dividend recommended. No material contingent liabilities disclosed.
